A '''''Delta''-class carrier''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. An example of this class was the carrier ''[[Extempus]]'', which was commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nezzor]] during the [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|Battle of Duro]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation" />

==Description==
Ships of this type were described as being able to carry two dozen interceptors,<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation" /> likely referring to [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptors]].<ref name="Interceptor"> Throughout the book "The Old Republic: Annihilation", ''Interceptor'' referred to ''Fury''-class Imperial interceptors, as shown during the [[Second battle of Leritor]]. As such it can be assumed, the ''Extempus''{{'}} starfighter complement was also comprised of ''Fury ''interceptors.</ref> Nezzors [[flagship]], the ''Extempus'', was also equipped with a [[Black cipher]] encryption device which means that the ''Delta''-class carrier must have been among the largest capital ships in the Imperial Navy.<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation" />
